item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 06/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A weak cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China during the day today. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, it will be windier and slightly cooler with one or two rain patches over the coastal areas midweek this week. Replenishments of the northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China over the weekend.

Weather: Sunny periods. One or two rain patches later.
Temp range: 24 - 30 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
